name: levels
label: Levels
css: .style-levels { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 64px; background-color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .style-levels::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #27272A) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; pointer-events: none; } .style-levels .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.02em; max-width: 90%; } .style-levels .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--text, #111827); margin: 24px 0 0 0; max-width: 85%; } .style-levels .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--text, #111827); opacity: 0.08; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .style-levels .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #27272A); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .slide-code.style-levels { background-color: #0F172A; background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, #1E293B 0%, #0F172A 100%); } .slide-code.style-levels .hook, .slide-code.style-levels .text { color: #F1F5F9; } .slide-code.style-levels .step { color: #F1F5F9; opacity: 0.12; } .slide-code.style-levels .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); } .slide-code.style-levels::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.1; } .slide-insight.style-levels { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1F2937 0%, #111827 100%); position: relative; } .slide-insight.style-levels .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); } .slide-insight.style-levels .text { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-insight.style-levels .insight-text { position: absolute; bottom: 64px; right: 32px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; max-width: 400px; text-align: left; } .slide-insight.style-levels .step { color: #F9FAFB; opacity: 0.15; } .slide-insight.style-levels .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6); } .slide-insight.style-levels::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #8B5CF6) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.12; }
